name: io.github.codespar/mcp-pagbrasil
description: PagBrasil — cross-border acquiring into Brazil: Pix, Boleto Flash, refunds

environmentVariables.name: PAGBRASIL_PBTOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Merchant token (pbtoken) from the PagBrasil Dashboard

environmentVariables.name: PAGBRASIL_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Secret phrase from the PagBrasil Dashboard

environmentVariables.name: PAGBRASIL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://sandbox.pagbrasil.com/api; production hosts are issued per-merchant.
